derivation_rules.object_schema: Project every object_type field, enum, cardinality, authority owner, invariant, and prohibition without semantic addition or omission.
derivation_rules.transition_schema: Project every transition exactly from transition_rules.
derivation_rules.dag_node: Create one node for every object_type.
derivation_rules.dag_edge: Create one directed edge for each transition source type to its destination type.
derivation_rules.rank: Every edge must satisfy destination rank greater than source rank.
derivation_rules.documentation: May explain the normative model but may not add authority, mandatory predecessors, transitions, cardinalities, or invariants.
derivation_rules.reconciliation: Compare projected object IDs and edge tuples for exact equality with the normative model.

invariants.text: Every engagement has exactly one authoritative current mandate.
Every workstream belongs to exactly one authoritative engagement.
Workstreams cannot expand their own mandate.
Client assertions cannot silently become verified facts.
Material claims require reconstructable evidence provenance.
Derived analysis cannot masquerade as primary evidence.
Material conclusions require traceable claim/evidence lineage.
Producing teams cannot independently certify their own material conclusions.
Independent validation cannot create engagement authority.
Challenge functions cannot mutate the original evidence record.
Recommendations cannot exist without predecessor findings and synthesis.
Failed validation cannot silently become approved delivery.
Engagement termination cannot be overridden by a subordinate workstream.
Implementation or investment handoff cannot create retroactive analytical authority.
Layers 00–14 authority and control guarantees remain intact.
Every transition moves strictly forward in rank; audit is never an authority predecessor.
Missing, stale, conflicting, cross-boundary, ambiguous, or inapplicable mandatory inputs fail closed.

Independent validation and recommendation bind the exact current ConclusionId/version set and matching EngagementId, MandateId, authority domain, ConclusionUseDomainId, provenance and freshness basis; substitution or stale consumption denies.
